# Chat

> Bittrees public-preview app for wallet messaging and an optional connected Mail inbox.

## Public information
- [About Chat](https://chat.bittrees.org/about): capabilities and preview limitations.
- [Support](https://chat.bittrees.org/support): help and safe bug reporting.
- [Security](https://chat.bittrees.org/security): private vulnerability reporting guidance.
- [Spanish support](https://chat.bittrees.org/es/support/): ayuda.
- [Spanish security](https://chat.bittrees.org/es/security/): informes de seguridad.

Messages, mailboxes, accounts, wallet actions and administration are private. This file grants no access to them. Mail requires explicit connection permission; room access depends on membership and service configuration. Automatic forwarding and a stable native release are not generally available.
